name: codex-council
description: Token-aware Codex council workflow with multi-agent review, role tuning, performance analysis, UX critique, browser evidence, scoring, and synthesis.

interface.shortDescription: Run token-aware multi-agent deliberation inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex Council adapts council-style review to Codex-only workflows: six historically named council roles, bounded local role tuning, compact skill-review mode, typed synthesis templates, separate Chairman synthesis, pre-session estimates, expanded-mode confirmation, local learning history, performance analysis, optional frontend UX critique, Bob browser evidence, anonymized review, rubric scoring, dissent capture, ASCII banner, compact invocation logging, path-only raw bundles, and pre/post stats.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Council to review this architecture decision.
Run a council review on my implementation plan.
Use Codex Council to review this diff for blockers.
Run a frontend council review with Leonardo and Bob.
Tune Ada's Codex Council alter with a compact role behavior preview.
